description_en: Creates an avatar training job. You can configure the basic information of the avatar and the materials required for the training
description_zh: 本接口用于创建数字人训练任务，配置数字人基础信息与训练所需要的素材信息等
kebab_example: aliyun ice create-avatar-training-job --avatar-name Decimal --avatar-description This_is_a_digital_human_used_for_a_specific_scenario. --avatar-type 2DAvatar --thumbnail https://your-bucket.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/thumbnail.png --portrait 0000571c704445f9a0ee011406c20000 --video 0000571c704445f9a0ee011406c20000 --transparent true --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAvatarTrainingJob

parameters.description_en:

parameters.description_en:
- The thumbnail URL.

- After the digital human is trained, the thumbnail is uploaded to this URL.

- The URL must be a valid public Object Storage Service (OSS) URL.

- The URL can be up to 512 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh:
缩略图 URL
- 训练成功后会将缩略图上传到这个地址中
- 必须是用户下合法的 OSS 公网 URL
- 不多于 512 个字符

parameters.description_en:
- The media asset ID of the portrait image.

- The value must be 32 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh:
- 头像图片的媒资 Id，长度为 32 个字符
- 如果后续调用 SubmitAvatarTrainingJob 提交训练，则本字段为必填
- 图片素材要求宽高相同

parameters.description_en:
- The ID of the video used for training.

- The value must be 32 characters in length.

- Supported formats: MP4, MOV, and WebM.

- The duration of the video must be 5 to 15 minutes.

- The resolution of the video must be 1920×1080 or 1080×1920.
parameters.description_zh:
训练视频媒资 ID
- 长度为 32 个字符
- 支持 mp4，mov，webm 格式
- 素材时长需在 5 分钟到 15 分钟内
- 素材分辨率需为 1920 * 1080 或 1080 * 1920
- 如果后续调用 SubmitAvatarTrainingJob 提交训练，则本字段为必填

parameters.description_en:
- Specifies whether the training video supports alpha channels.

  \*\*

  **Note**: Make sure that the current settings are consistent with those of the submitted training video. Otherwise, the digital human may malfunction.
